ToolDefinition.Name: GCC Help
ToolDefinition.Hint: Checks GCC availability and captures gcc --help output
ToolDefinition.Description:
Checks whether GCC is present in the system PATH. Running the tool executes 'gcc --help', saves the output to a file in the configured output directory, and displays it in a dialog. Viewing shows the previously saved output file, or reports an error if it has not been generated yet.
Setting: output_filename – name of the file written inside the output directory (default: gcc_help.txt)
